issue.title: Does not work with target es2015

repository.name: angular-router-loader
repository.description: A Webpack loader that enables string-based module loading with the Angular Router

issue.body:
When the target is set to `es2015` in tsconfig.json, the js fails to execute in the browser because of:

https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/19978

The error is `Uncaught TypeError: Cannot convert undefined or null to object`.

The workaround is to not generate arrow functions here:
https://github.com/brandonroberts/angular-router-loader/blob/master/src/utils.js#L47

Replacing the generated code to use `function() { }` instead of `() => { }` will work around this.

Would you accept a PR for this change?

body: Inline function also not always compiles with no errors. I had to use exported named function as the argument of "loadChildren:". Any chances to add support for lamda/arrow functions here?
